newsitem.title: USA: RF Power sasy awarded $3 MLN contracts.
newsitem.headline: RF Power sasy awarded $3 MLN contracts.

text.p: RF Power Products Inc said two semiconductor-equipment manufacturers have awarded it new contracts for its radio-frequency (RF) generators and associated matching networks valued at about $3 million.
Deliveries under these contracts are scheduled over the next 12 months.

RF Power designs and manufactures radio-frequency power systems, matching networks and other peripheral products primarily for original-equipment manufacturers in the semiconductor, flat panel display, thin film disc media and analytical instrument markets.
